scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace backend && playwright test
scripts.prod:up: bash scripts/compose-production.sh down --remove-orphans && bash scripts/compose-production.sh up -d --remove-orphans
